newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens stocks close lower in healthy profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Athens stocks close lower in healthy profit taking.

text.p: The Athens bourse ended 0.65 percent lower with market watchers saying Thursday's session was marked by profit taking and expecting a new resistance level at 1,080 points on the benchmark index.
"The market corrected after profit taking on Thursday. The correction was normal and the new resistance level seems to be at 1,080 points," said Iakovos Diamantopoulos, a broker at Hermes Brokerage.
He added that today's correction was expected after the market's rise in the past few sessions.
The Athens general share index slipped 0.65 percent or 6.91 points at 1063.10 from Wednesday's 1070.01, after opening at 1074.23.

"Market sentiment is very positive and people who were attracted to the bourse after bonds were taxed in the beginning of the year are reallocating funds from one sector to the other as it is the most attractive investment alternative," Diamantopoulos added.
Other analysts agreed that the market went through a desirable correction.
"The market was correcting on Thursday, which is a healthy reaction to its recent rise. Overall, supplly of stocks was met by demand," said Maria Douli, an analyst at Sigma Securities.
She added that both retail and institutional investors shown an interest in Greek stocks and especially blue chips which she expects will continue to rally.
Banks, cement companies and telecommunications shares will perform well in the near future, Douli said.

Banks declined 0.19 percent, construction dropped 1.60 percent while small caps lost 0.25 percent. Industrials closed 0.73 down. Holding companies gained 1.95 percent while investment shares lost 0.29 percent.
Thursday's turnover was 12.5 billion drachmas on volume of 5.3 million shares. Losers led gainers 130 to 97 with 22 issues unchanged on 249 traded.
Shares of Balcan Export and Intrasoft were among the most heavily traded. On Wednesday, Intrasoft announced it won a 1.0 billion drachma software contract with Malta's Bank of Valletta.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 846.00-864.00. Shares of OTE telecom the underlying, dropped 105 drachmas to 5,160.

The recently launched ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted higher at $14.06-$15.06. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted at 6,004-6,389 drachmas. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
